mezo.create.lede: Invoice in MUSD, the dollar of the Mezo network, which people mint by borrowing against their bitcoin. Your client pays from their own wallet, *straight to yours*. Creating an invoice costs nothing: no gas, no sign-up, no platform fee.
mezo.create.step3: Your client checks the invoice and pays from their wallet, which pays a small network fee in BTC. The MUSD go straight to you; nothing is held in between.
mezo.pay.billLede: Compare the amount and the address with what the seller told you. When you approve, the MUSD go *straight from your wallet to theirs*. PayLink never holds them.
mezo.pay.openLede: This link has no set price, like a tip jar. Type what you want to send and check the address. The MUSD go *straight from your wallet to theirs*.
mezo.pay.step2: Your wallet asks you to approve the payment, then sends it. It pays the small network fee, in BTC.
mezo.pay.assure: Non-custodial: the MUSD go straight from your wallet to the address above. Your wallet pays the network fee, in BTC.
mezo.pay.needsBtc: This wallet holds no BTC for the network fee. On Mezo the payer's wallet pays it: get a little test BTC, then check again.
mezo.pay.waitBtc: Waiting for BTC for the fee
mezo.ledger.cancelNoGas: Cancelling sends one transaction from your wallet: it needs a little {coin} for the network fee.
mezo.wallet.lede: Wallets installed in this browser. PayLink never sees your keys: your wallet shows you everything before you approve. Use an EVM wallet such as MetaMask: Bitcoin wallets that need Mezo Passport cannot connect here yet.
mezo.wallet.none: No wallet found in this browser. On a phone, open this page in your wallet's own browser (MetaMask, Rabby…). On a computer, install a wallet extension, then reload. Bitcoin wallets that need Mezo Passport cannot connect here yet.
mezo.notes.title: MUSD and BTC on Mezo
mezo.notes.musdText: is the dollar of the Mezo network. People mint it by borrowing against bitcoin they lock as collateral, worth at least 110% of the loan. PayLink moves it from wallet to wallet and never holds it.
mezo.notes.feeText: Signing an invoice sends nothing, so it is free. Paying is one transaction from the payer's wallet, and its fee is paid in BTC, Mezo's gas coin: a tiny amount, but the wallet needs some.
mezo.notes.gaslessText: Elsewhere PayLink can pay the fee for your client, with dollars that accept signed transfers (EIP-3009). MUSD accepts permits (EIP-2612) instead, so the payer's own wallet sends the payment.
mezo.notes.issuerText: On Mezo testnet, the owner of the MUSD contract can allow chosen addresses to mint MUSD, or to burn it from any account. That power is the issuer's, not PayLink's.
mezo.test.title: Test MUSD, step by step
mezo.test.btcText: From the Mezo faucet, behind a captcha, or by asking in the #testnet channel of Mezo's Discord.
mezo.test.borrowText: MUSD has no faucet: you borrow it against your test BTC in Mezo's testnet app. The smallest loan is 1,800 MUSD, and Mezo adds a 200 MUSD reserve and a 0.1% fee to the debt: plan on about 0.04 test BTC of collateral.
mezo.test.borrowAlt: If that page does not open, try
mezo.test.payText: Send MUSD to your test payers with a plain transfer, and a little test BTC for their fees. Then share your link: each payer opens it and pays.
mezo.funds.musd: MUSD has no faucet: borrow it against test BTC in Mezo's testnet app, or ask someone who holds some to send it.
mezo.funds.btc: The network fee is paid in BTC, and this wallet holds none. Get test BTC from the Mezo faucet, then check again.
mezo.fee.line: Network fee: about {sats} sat, paid in BTC by your wallet.
mezo.fee.basis: An upper estimate: the gas limit PayLink sets for this payment times the network's current gas price. Your wallet shows the exact fee before you approve.
mezo.status.tokenOk: {name} ({symbol}), {decimals} decimals · permit (EIP-2612): yes · signed transfers (EIP-3009): no, as the registry says.
mezo.status.tokenErr: The token on the network does not match the registry.
mezo.status.feeValue: Paid in BTC by the payer: about {sats} sat per payment at the current gas price.
mezo.status.gaslessValue: Not on Mezo: MUSD has no signed transfers (EIP-3009), so each payer's wallet sends the payment.
